pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

11. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

7. B — Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Nairobi
